node.statement: Uniform definitional bounds: there are universal finite constants a,b,k and a universal threshold e_0>0 such that, whenever e=delta+epsilon<=e_0 and T is a delta-projection, (i) either ||T||<=a*delta or T is nonvanishing, (ii) u_T=Co_T(T), ||Co_T-L_T R_T||<=k*e, and ||XY||<=(1+epsilon)||X||||Y||, and (iii) if T is nonvanishing then abs(||u_T||-1)<=b*e.
